```plato
    // The IMesh3D obligation. No welding: positions are the flattened corners
    // and the faces index them consecutively, so a mesh with shared vertices
    // requires a separate weld pass.
    ToTriangleMesh(a: TriangleArray3D): TriangleMesh3D
        => (a.Points,
            a.Triangles.Count.MapRange(i =>
                TriangleFace(VertexIndex(3 * i), VertexIndex(3 * i + 1), VertexIndex(3 * i + 2))));
```

```plato
    // The IMesh3D obligation: two triangles per quad over the flattened
    // corners.
    ToTriangleMesh(a: QuadArray3D): TriangleMesh3D
        => (a.Points,
            a.Quads.Count.MapRange(i => i).FlatMap(i => a.QuadTriangleFaces(i)));
```

```plato
    // The IMesh3D obligation: two triangles per quad over the shared
    // positions, split on the A-C diagonal (the fan from corner 0).
    ToTriangleMesh(self: QuadMesh3D): TriangleMesh3D
        => (self.Positions, self.Faces.FlatMap(q => q.FanTriangles));
```

```plato
    // The boundary surface: the positions unchanged, and the faces that no
    // second cell shares.
    ToTriangleMesh(self: TetrahedralMesh3D): TriangleMesh3D {
        var candidates = self.CandidateFaces;
        var empty = candidates.Take(0);
        var boundary = candidates.FlatMap(face =>
            candidates.Reduce(0, (acc, other) => SameFaceKey(face, other) ? acc + 1 : acc) == 1
                ? empty.Append(face)
                : empty);
        return (self.Positions, boundary);
    }
}
```
